// Firebase Firestore Collection Schema Documentation

/**
 * USERS COLLECTION
 * Path: /users/{userId}
 * 
 * Document Structure:
 * {
 *   userId: string (auto-generated by Firebase Auth)
 *   phoneNumber: string
 *   username: string
 *   email: string (optional)
 *   avatar: string (URL)
 *   bio: string
 *   role: 'user' | 'host' | 'admin'
 *   status: 'active' | 'banned' | 'inactive'
 *   coinsBalance: number
 *   diamondsBalance: number
 *   totalEarnings: number (host only)
 *   followers: number
 *   following: number
 *   createdAt: timestamp
 *   updatedAt: timestamp
 *   lastActiveAt: timestamp
 * }
 */

/**
 * PARTY ROOMS COLLECTION
 * Path: /party_rooms/{roomId}
 * 
 * Document Structure:
 * {
 *   roomId: string
 *   hostId: string
 *   title: string
 *   description: string
 *   category: string
 *   roomCover: string (URL)
 *   status: 'active' | 'ended' | 'suspended'
 *   onlineCount: number
 *   maxViewers: number
 *   isPrivate: boolean
 *   coHostIds: string[] (array of user IDs)
 *   gifts: number (total gifts received)
 *   totalCoinsGenerated: number
 *   rating: number (0-5)
 *   createdAt: timestamp
 *   startedAt: timestamp
 *   endedAt: timestamp
 *   updatedAt: timestamp
 * }
 * 
 * Subcollections:
 * - messages/{messageId}
 * - viewers/{viewerId}
 * - gifts/{giftId}
 */

/**
 * WALLETS COLLECTION
 * Path: /wallets/{userId}
 * 
 * Document Structure:
 * {
 *   userId: string
 *   coinsBalance: number
 *   diamondsBalance: number
 *   totalCoinsEarned: number
 *   totalDiamondsEarned: number
 *   totalCoinsSpent: number
 *   totalDiamondsSpent: number
 *   totalWithdrawn: number
 *   updatedAt: timestamp
 * }
 * 
 * Subcollections:
 * - coin_transactions/{transactionId}
 * - diamond_transactions/{transactionId}
 */

/**
 * WITHDRAWALS COLLECTION
 * Path: /withdrawals/{withdrawalId}
 * 
 * Document Structure:
 * {
 *   withdrawalId: string
 *   userId: string
 *   amount: number (in diamonds)
 *   amountInUSD: number
 *   paymentMethod: 'bank' | 'wallet' | 'upi'
 *   accountDetails: string
 *   status: 'pending' | 'approved' | 'paid' | 'rejected'
 *   reason: string (rejection reason)
 *   requestedAt: timestamp
 *   approvedAt: timestamp
 *   paidAt: timestamp
 *   approvedBy: string (admin userId)
 *   transactionId: string (external payment gateway ID)
 * }
 */

/**
 * GIFTS COLLECTION
 * Path: /gifts/{giftId}
 * 
 * Document Structure:
 * {
 *   giftId: string
 *   name: string
 *   icon: string (URL)
 *   coinCost: number
 *   diamondCost: number
 *   description: string
 *   animation: string (animation URL)
 *   category: string
 *   isActive: boolean
 *   createdAt: timestamp
 * }
 */

/**
 * REPORTS COLLECTION
 * Path: /reports/{reportId}
 * 
 * Document Structure:
 * {
 *   reportId: string
 *   reporterId: string
 *   reportedUserId: string (if user report)
 *   reportedRoomId: string (if room report)
 *   reportedMessageId: string (if message report)
 *   category: 'inappropriate_content' | 'harassment' | 'spam' | 'copyright' | 'other'
 *   description: string
 *   evidence: string[] (URLs of evidence)
 *   status: 'new' | 'investigating' | 'resolved' | 'dismissed'
 *   action: string (ban | warn | warning_sent | no_action)
 *   notes: string (admin notes)
 *   createdAt: timestamp
 *   resolvedAt: timestamp
 *   resolvedBy: string (admin userId)
 * }
 */

/**
 * BLOCKS COLLECTION
 * Path: /blocks/{blockId}
 * 
 * Document Structure:
 * {
 *   blockId: string
 *   blockerId: string
 *   blockedId: string
 *   reason: string
 *   createdAt: timestamp
 * }
 */

/**
 * NOTIFICATIONS COLLECTION
 * Path: /notifications/{userId}/messages/{notificationId}
 * 
 * Document Structure:
 * {
 *   notificationId: string
 *   type: 'gift' | 'follow' | 'message' | 'room_live' | 'system'
 *   title: string
 *   body: string
 *   data: object (type-specific data)
 *   isRead: boolean
 *   createdAt: timestamp
 * }
 */

/**
 * ADMIN LOGS COLLECTION
 * Path: /admin_logs/{logId}
 * 
 * Document Structure:
 * {
 *   logId: string
 *   adminId: string
 *   action: string (ban_user | unban_user | approve_withdrawal | reject_withdrawal | etc.)
 *   targetUserId: string (if applicable)
 *   targetId: string (room/withdrawal/etc. ID)
 *   description: string
 *   changes: object
 *   createdAt: timestamp
 * }
 */

/**
 * CONFIG COLLECTION
 * Path: /config/{documentId}
 * 
 * Example Documents:
 * - /config/app_settings
 * - /config/pricing
 * - /config/features
 */
